notes: Real clip (window 1.20-2.74 s = clip frames 29-66, previs frames 322-359): locked-off, ground-level rear shot on wet dark tarmac that looks like an airfield / empty runway road (no lane lines, two dark skid-mark bands in a V, mirror-like wet reflections of the tail lamps, fog, a string of orange lights on the horizon at the left, teal haze). The camera does not move at all (horizon lights and skid marks stay on the same pixels, +-1 px) and sits only ~0.27 m above the road (wheel contacts 22 px below the horizon at a 143 px wide car; tail-lamp height checks out at 0.23-0.27 m), exactly behind the car (car centre x 0.495), level apart from ~1.6 deg of pitch up (the vanishing point of the road edge is at y=0.545 of the frame height, not 0.5). The pearl-white coupe accelerates away from near standstill: body width 143 px (22% of the frame width) at window start, 106 / 80 / 57 / 42 px at 25/50/75/100%, i.e. rear-plane distance 7.1 m -> 23.2 m at 32 mm (about 6 m/s -> 14 m/s, still accelerating; distance follows d = 7.1 + 16.1 (t/T)^1.5 within 0.28 m rms), rear view, taillights ~0.64 of the body width apart. Previs: camera fixed at (0,-47,0.27), aim (0,53,3.12) = 1.63 deg pitch up, 32 mm; car yaw 0 on the Y axis from y=-37.7 to y=-21.6 (rear plane 7.1 m -> 23.2 m ahead of the camera) with car_ease 1.5. The camera y was chosen (-47) so that the gantry row at y=-50 is behind the lens and the next one is 117 m ahead, and the pole rows stay at the edge of the frame. Check (previs vs real) at 0/25/50/75/100%: car body width 0.229/0.178/0.127/0.092/0.068 vs 0.225/0.166/0.125/0.089/0.066 of the frame width (the previs silhouette includes the 1.78 m wing, a constant +3-4% bias, so the real error is within 3% except ~+4% at 25%), car centre x 0.499 vs 0.495, car centre y 0.44/0.46/0.49/0.50/0.51 vs 0.44/-/-/-/0.50, horizon 0.545 vs ~0.545; frame-difference max/median 2.55 but smooth (monotone decay as the car shrinks, local max/median 1.13): no pop. Remaining mismatches: the highway builder env is a city highway (skyline blocks, rails, lamp poles, gantry at y=70 that frames the car in the second half) while the real is an open dark airfield with only a low string of orange lights; lane dashes at +-1.75 m and solid lines at +-5.5 m exist in the previs while the real has no markings (road edge ~3.5 m left of the camera); wet reflections / fog / glow are not representable; the previs car's rear is a box with a big wing and a single round lamp per side (real: 2 round lamps per side, small spoiler); the car starts slightly too close at 25% of the window (distance 9.0 vs 9.4 m) because the u^1.5 ease starts at speed 0 while the real car already moves at ~6 m/s at the window start; the lens is not constrained by the clip (a longer lens only moves the camera back and scales the distances: 24 mm -> 5.3 m, 50 mm -> 11 m).
